# TG Downloader

> Full content index for TG Downloader. Use this file when `/llms.txt` is too compact and an AI agent needs the main product pages, language entrances, and update pages.

## Core Product

- [TG Downloader Home](https://telegramdownloadmedia.com/): Main Telegram video download entry with link parsing, private-channel guidance, troubleshooting, and Chrome extension installation path.
- [Pricing](https://telegramdownloadmedia.com/pricing/): Buy one-time Credits or upgrade to Unlimited monthly plugin access.
- [About TG Downloader](https://telegramdownloadmedia.com/about/): Product identity, website and extension responsibilities, privacy principles, and access boundaries.
- [Contact TG Downloader](https://telegramdownloadmedia.com/contact/): Public support channel for account, download, extension, billing, and privacy questions.
- [Short LLMs index](https://telegramdownloadmedia.com/llms.txt): Compact AI-readable summary of the website and its highest-value pages.

## Product Pages

- [Product changelog](https://telegramdownloadmedia.com/changelog/): Track Telegram download updates, media workflow changes, larger file support, and release notes.

## Key Facts

- Product name: TG Downloader.
- Site domain: `telegramdownloadmedia.com`.
- Platform type: Browser website plus Chrome extension assisted Telegram Web workflow.
- Website parser pages: Telegram, TikTok, X/Twitter, Vimeo, Instagram, and Threads.
- Telegram extension workflow: Designed for media already visible to the user in Telegram Web, including private-channel, restricted-save, large-file, and batch queue workflows.
- Language coverage: 14 locales using per-language sitemap files.
- Safety boundary: TG Downloader should not ask for Telegram passwords, verification codes, API credentials, or session files.
